title: Stephen Bond
text:
Welcome!
Hello, thanks for stopping by my website! My name is Stephen, a current third year Environmental Studies major with a concentration in Physical Geography at UCSB.
While I currently call Santa Barbara home, I am originally from Massachusetts.
This website acts as a collection of my academic and professional experiences, personal interests, and some delicious recipes. I hope this provides a little slice of who I am!


Currently
While I still am in undergad, I currently work for the Santa Barbara County Association of Governments as a GIS intern, the Isla Vista Community Service district as a Sustainability Staff Lead, and Associated Students Recycling as a route Rider. I learned from these positions that I find the my work most meaningful when it is rooted in local government and community initiatives. Seeing hard work overtime directly benefit a place so close to home is what drives me to continue making advancements to our community and bolster environmental initiatives.
When I am not too busy working, I love volunteering for Sprout Up a national nonprofit focused on providing free environmental education to Title I elementary schools. I also find myself enjoying a good board game with my friends and family, exploring the outdoors, or traveling.


Education
Bachelor of Science, Environmental Studies, 2027 University of California, Santa Barbara

title: About Me
text:
I grew up in Walpole, Massachusetts, a small suburban town forty minutes south of Boston. My immediate family consists of myself, my two brothers, and my parents, but I was fortunate enough to live close to my grandparents, aunts and uncles, and cousins.



My Family





My Cousins and I at Cape Cod


Along with my Family, I have a a wonderful group of friends in Santa Barbara and Walpole. Some of which I have known since middle school to some that I met this year.



Hometown Friends





Santa Barbara Friends





Outside of time with friends and family, you can find me at any live music event. Whether it be a small band show in Isla Vista or a stadium event, concerts help me relax and unwind.



Charli XCX, San Diego 2024





Omar Apollo, Santa Barbara 2024


 Additionally, I also discovered a love for travelling after studying abroad in Copenhagen. I was fortunate enought to visit countries ranging from Germany, Italy, Spain, Sweden, and Czechia. I made great friends and memories along the way, and I hope I can travel again soon to make even more memories.
